audio.signalPath: Owned stereo voices -> per-layer summed bus -> Mod 1 -> Mod 2 -> Delay with filter inside feedback loop -> Amp/EQ/24dB filter -> Compressor -> Reverb -> shared Rotary phase/speed when To Rotary selected (separate layer histories) -> each layer level -> shared master gain -> tanh soft limiter -> one stereo worklet output -> one AudioContext destination
audio.stealing: Inherited deterministic released, sustained, oldest-held priority within each layer; source-instance ownership retained.
audio.status: Idle, loading, context ready or error/retry. Library status separately remains fallback when recordings are absent or fail. OLED reports recordings unavailable; selected recorded-type LED flashes. The app never reports the primary recorded library ready when fallback is active.

effects.implementation: Original deterministic DSP, shared unchanged between browser AudioWorklet and rendered signal tests. Approximation of the documented effect families, not vendor DSP.
effects.types: Every type in inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.effects.json is selectable. EQ-only and To Rotary share their local EQ processing; To Rotary additionally uses the shared downstream rotor.
effects.rotary: One shared smoothly accelerating horn/bass rotor clock; separate stereo history per layer allows required post-rotary layer levels.
effects.ramps: 10ms smoothing of effect parameters, bypass, levels and master; 20ms crossfade on effect type changes; 5ms voice stealing stop ramp; rotary speed accelerates over approximately 650ms.
effects.groupGlobal: Piano group edits both chains. Delay/Compressor/Reverb global copies current settings and targets both Piano chains. Organ/Synth are inactive and contribute no sources this phase.

notes: There are no bundled recordings. The recorded Grand/Upright/Electric hard gate remains unmet under the input-only constraint.
Soft/sostenuto pedal, half pedaling and pedal noise are not implemented or claimed.
String resonance is additive sympathetic resonance when other voices or the pedal are held, not a recording.
All notes naturally decay and are retired after 12 seconds at the latest.
The inherited Phase 1 BrowserAudio and tests remain intact as historical regression fixtures; the production app uses LayerAudio and LayeredPianoEngine.
All-effects stop clears voice and delay/reverb history. The worklet owns no application timers. Disposal closes the context, port and callbacks.

hardware.action: Hammer action (hardware variant designation; browser keys are pointer/keyboard inputs)
hardware.presentationState: Original ID inventory and geometry preserved. Piano/effects/master/pitch/rotary bindings read canonical InstrumentState; other controls retain isolated presentation state. Accessible expandable details expose controls missing from the compact inherited surface.
hardware.geometryPrecedence: Visual spec v1.4 and photo override the obsolete fractions in the phase prompt.
hardware.narrowInspection: Full instrument overview at 94% width; Inspect surface enlarges to 1400px in an independently scrollable viewport.

boundaries.audio: LayerAudioBoundary, AudioContext and AudioWorkletNode factories, injectable sample loader. Production InstrumentDSP is also invoked directly for deterministic rendered tests. Message barriers synchronize browser offline rendering.
boundaries.midi: RequestMidi and MidiAccess interfaces injected into InputController.
boundaries.events: Window target injected into InputController.attach; pure input methods available for device-free tests.
boundaries.timing: DSP sample clock; injected clock for tap tempo; no application timers.
boundaries.storage: No storage reads or writes; all state is in memory.

unsupported: Recorded Grand/Upright/Electric sample sets: missing from supplied inputs; labeled synthesis fallback provided.
Organ and Synth engines, programs, Live, splits, zones, scenes, morphs, transpose and master program clock controls.
Piano pedal noise, half pedaling, Triple Pedal hardware, soft/sostenuto pedal, size classes, INFO, Sound Manager and preset library.
Effect variations, reverb Chorale, delay feedback-loop special effects and Analog, Pump/Wah pedal modes, rotary close mic, stop mode/angle and morph assignment.
Aftertouch, Extern/Aux KB/MIDI menus and Nord hardware integration.
